3639080690.detail_text: At doomoo, we know that pregnancy and the postpartum period are both magical and intense times. To support women through these changes, we have partnered with Shinncare, a Belgian brand specialising in feminine care developed by gynaecologists, to create a natural, soothing and effective body oil. Enhancing Body Oil is composed of 23 natural active ingredients, carefully selected for their nourishing, repairing and protective properties. Among them: • Olive oil – deeply nourishes and protects the skin’s natural barrier. • Sweet almond oil – improves elasticity and helps prevent stretch marks. • Rosemary – revitalises and stimulates the skin. Its dry texture absorbs instantly without leaving any greasy residue, so you can get dressed immediately after application. The delicate scent of vanilla, chamomile and almond transforms your routine into a real cocooning ritual, a moment of calm and connection with your body. Dermatologically tested and rated 19.3/20 on INCI Beauty and 100/100 on Yuka, it is safe for sensitive skin, vegan, and fully compliant with EU cosmetic standards. Why you’ll love doomoo x Shinncare Enhancing Body Oil: • Deeply moisturises and nourishes your skin. • Helps prevent and reduce stretch marks. • Soothes tightness and discomfort caused by stretching skin. • Protects the skin from external stress and dryness. • Quick-absorbing and non-greasy texture for daily use. • Gentle scent of vanilla, chamomile and almond. • Safe for pregnant and breastfeeding women. Apply a few drops morning and evening on your belly, hips, breasts, and thighs, massaging gently in circular motions. Use it from the start of pregnancy and throughout postpartum for long-lasting hydration and comfort. How to Use 1. Place a few drops in the palm of your hands. 2. Use circular movements on the stomach, hips, chest and thighs. 3. Use morning and evening from the beginning of pregnancy and after childbirth.
